content:
**The drawer is pinned to the viewport with its own scroll (#1307)**

The drawer was page-tall (5053 px) and scrolled with the page, so a node opened at scrollY 2600 rendered at top -2365 px. Fix: .drawer is position:sticky; top:0; max-height:100vh with a drawer-head (id, chips, tabs, close) and a scrolling drawer-body. Measured at 1600x1100, scroll 2600, card #878: drawer [0,1100], tabs top 45 before and after scrolling the body to its max. Gotcha: tabs sticky inside the body never engage for an epic (49-children list pushes them to the bottom), so the tab bar moved into the fixed head, above the title (D120). Status bar is not sticky, so at scroll 0 the drawer's tail sits below the fold until the page scrolls (D119).
